verdict.rationale: Bento is an agent tracing and observability product, so masking or redacting sensitive data before it is stored in traces is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents redaction, masking, PII scrubbing, or span-attribute filtering before storage. The `init()` kwargs (user_id, session_id, tags) and span tagging only add metadata; they do not remove sensitive data.

support.subject: As a developer, I can mask or redact sensitive data before it is stored in traces
